semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in the distribution of semiconductor materials and components, including sputtering targets and O-rings.
summary: Global Precise Instrument Corporation is a key distributor of semiconductor materials, including high-purity metals and sputtering targets. They also provide professional repair technology and imported bearings, serving major semiconductor manufacturers in Taiwan.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company serves major semiconductor manufacturers across northern, central, and southern Taiwan.
